title: Generated Claude Code wrapper
description: The frontmatter of wrappers/claude/<name>.md as eva.py generate writes it (unit B2, plan.md:962, :965), read by the strict frontmatter reader. Closed at every level: Claude Code ignores a field it does not recognize (inputs/agent-master-skills.md section 3.4), so an unknown key is caught here, not by the parity rows. Properties: the target's required keys plus its wrapper fields (targets/claude.json).
